Select IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target Acetylcholinesterase identified by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1914. Return every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Output columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures, INNER JOIN required, exclude null SMILES), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id when non-null, else docs.doi; exclude rows where both are null), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Join path: activities INNER JOIN assays on assay_id, INNER JOIN target_dictionary on assays.tid, INNER JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id, INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, INNER JOIN compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno, INNER JOIN docs on activities.doc_id. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1914', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) IS NOT NULL. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
